children: , the parent company of bankcda, is pleased to announce its results for the third quarter 2026.
COEUR D'ALENE, ID / ACCESS Newswire / October 20, 2026 /

, today reported net income of $613,020 or $0.32 per share for the third quarter 2026, compared to $402,111 or $0.21 per share for the third quarter 2025. Net income of $1,454,491 or $0.77 per share for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, was also reported, compared to $1,024,764 or $0.54 per share for the nine months ended 2025. All results are unaudited.

"We are pleased with our results for the first nine months, with continued improvement in our profitability and growth of both loans and deposits. Although the interest rate environment continues to be challenging, we have been able to improve our net interest margin due to our strong core deposit base. We anticipate breaking ground on a permanent full service branch in Richland, WA in the coming months, with an anticipated grand opening in late third quarter 2027," said Wes Veach, President and Chief Executive Officer.
Diluted earnings per share were $0.75 for nine months ended 2026, versus $0.53 per share for nine months ended 2025.
Net book value per share ended the quarter at $13.57 compared to $13.44 one year ago.

Annualized return on average assets (ROAA) was 0.82% and annualized return on average equity (ROAE) was 7.40% for nine months ended 2026, compared to 0.59% and 5.67% for nine months ended 2025, respectively.
Total assets ended the period at $242.2 million compared to $237.3 million as of September 30, 2025, an increase of 2.1%.
Gross loans were $146.7 million at quarter end, versus $130.1 million on September 30, 2025, an increase of $16.6 million or 12.8%.
Total deposits were $214.4 million, compared to $204.0 million as of September 30, 2025, an increase of $10.4 million or 5.1%.
For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, the net interest margin was 4.42%, compared to 3.99% for the nine months ended September 30, 2025.
Nonperforming assets to Tier 1 capital ended the quarter at 12.17%.
We continue to be FIVE Star-rated from Bauer Financial, which is their highest rating.
We continue to far exceed the minimum community bank leverage ratio.
Coeur d'Alene Bancorp, parent company of bankcda, is headquartered in Coeur d'Alene, Idaho with branches in Coeur d'Alene, Hayden, Post Falls, Kellogg, Spokane, and Richland.
